sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:21

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:21:1
items.html:
The light of the upper Ozen was already completed and sealed at the Shibolet of the beard: For three vessels are discerned from the Tabur upward, and they were made from the secret of the departure of the lights, as was written above, page 311, item 27: that at the departure of the light of Malchut to ZA the vessel of Malchut was made, from the Tabur to the Chazeh; and at the departure of the light of ZA the vessel of ZA was made, from the Chazeh to the Shibolet; and at the departure of the light of Bina the vessel of Bina was made in the place of the Shibolet. And it turns out because of this that the light of Bina concludes in the place of the Shibolet, since she has no vessel below the Shibolet of the beard; and the light of ZA concludes at the Chazeh, and the light of Malchut at the Tabur. And this is what he says, that the light of the upper Ozen was already completed and sealed at the Shibolet of the beard.
And there is yet another reason for the sealing of the light of the Ozen in the place of the Shibolet of the beard. For in truth the Shibolet and the Parsa are one and the same, and both of them were made by the force of the restriction of NHY and the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim. For behold, the AHP went out into the discernment of a Guf [body], as above, and accordingly the discernment of the Peh [mouth] descended and became the discernment of a Tabur, where the Parsa was spread out. But the difference is that the Peh is, in its source, the Malchut of the Rosh [head], and only by reason of its receiving the light of the Einayim did it descend to the discernment of a Tabur; whereas the Parsa is in the place of the original Tabur, which even in the Partzufim that preceded the light of the Einayim was of the discernment of a Tabur. And it turns out that just as there is a Parsa at the original Tabur of the general AK, which is above its NHY, that are ZON, as above, so there is a Parsa above the Mazal, which are the discernment of the NHY and the ZON of the Dikna [beard], as above, where the upper surface is the secret of ZA and the lower surface is the secret of Malchut, and both of them together are called Mazal. And this Parsa that is above the Mazal is the secret of the Shibolet of the beard. And it turns out that just as the Parsa concludes SAG, and it is cut off above the Tabur and the Parsa, so the Shibolet of the beard concludes the light of the Ozen, which is the discernment of the SAG that is in the Rosh, and it does not shine below the Shibolet, but only the Hotem and Peh of the Rosh, which are ZON alone, as in the NHY of the general AK. Therefore the light of the upper Ozen is sealed at the Shibolet of the beard, in such a way that from below the Shibolet of the beard there is no illumination of GAR [first three] there, which is the light of the Ozen, but VAK [six ends] without GAR, which are only the discernment of Hotem and Peh alone. Understand this well.
And this is what he says in item 22: “And for this reason the first three kings did not die.” For the light of GAR was in them from the beginning of their emanation, that is, the light of the Ozen, which is the light of Bina. But “the seven lower kings died,” for there is in them nothing of the light of GAR at the beginning of their emanation, and therefore they could not bear the illumination of GAR that reached them from the Yesod of AK, as is written in its place.
